meta_title: North Decorating Services | Painter Decorator Newcastle
meta_description: North Decorating Services in Newcastle offers interior and exterior painting, decorating, and wallpapering. Local, reliable, fully insured. Get your free quote today.
hero_subhead: Transform your home with expert interior and exterior decorating. Free quotes, honest pricing, and work you'll love.
services_subhead: From interior redecoration to exterior painting, we handle every project with care and precision.

services.title: Interior Painting & Decorating
services.desc: Refresh your living spaces with expertly applied paint, wallpaper, and finishes. We protect your furniture and leave no mess behind.

services.title: Exterior Painting
services.desc: Weather-resistant exterior painting for your home's woodwork, masonry, and doors. We use premium paints built to last through Newcastle winters.

services.title: Wallpapering & Wall Coverings
services.desc: Professional hanging of wallpaper, feature walls, and contemporary wall coverings. Smooth, bubble-free finishes every time.

services.title: Woodwork Restoration
services.desc: Strip, sand, and repaint skirting boards, window frames, doors, and other timber. Bring tired woodwork back to life with a flawless finish.

services.title: Ceiling Work
services.desc: Ceiling painting, artexing removal, and repair. We work safely at height and leave surfaces smooth and professional.

services.title: Commercial Decorating
services.desc: Office spaces, retail units, and commercial properties painted on schedule and within budget. Minimal disruption to your business.

about_pullquote: We show up on time, do the job right, and treat your home with respect.
about_para_1: North Decorating Services has been transforming homes and businesses across Newcastle for over 15 years. We started because we saw too many corners being cut in the trade — missed deadlines, sloppy prep work, and poor-quality finishes. Our approach is different: we take time to prepare surfaces properly, use premium materials, and leave your home cleaner than we found it.
about_para_2: Our customers return to us because we listen, we're honest about what a job needs, and we deliver consistent, professional results. We're fully insured, we work safely, and we stand behind every project. Whether it's a single bedroom or a full commercial refurb, we bring the same level of care and attention to detail.
reviews_heading: What Newcastle Homeowners Say About Us

reviews.text: Brilliant job redecorating our lounge. Mark turned up exactly when he said he would, worked tidy, and the finish is beautiful. Couldn't fault it. Already planning to have him back for the hallway next year.

reviews.text: Needed our skirting boards and doors painted after moving in. Very professional team, they protected everything properly and left no mess. The quality of the finish is excellent. Would definitely recommend.

reviews.text: Had exterior woodwork painted before winter. They were efficient, fair priced, and the work has held up brilliantly. Would use again without hesitation.
